statusCode.description_en:
If the request to the target site succeeds, the HTTP status code of the target URL is returned.

If the request to the target site fails, a custom error code is returned:

    2.1 4030: The target site has security restrictions, such as robots.txt or security policies.
    
    2.2 4080: The request timed out.
    
    2.3 4290: The rate limiting policy of the site was triggered.
    
    2.4 5010: An unknown exception occurred
statusCode.description_zh:
若目标站点请求成功，返回目标 url 的 HttpCode。

若目标站点请求失败，返回 IQS 定制错误码：

    2.1 4030：目标站点安全限制（robots.txt、安全策略等）
    
    2.2 4080：请求超时
    
    2.3 4290：触发站点限流策略
    
    2.4 5010：未知异常

description_en: Reads HTML and parses web page content in a browser sandbox environment. The operation starts parsing after the resources on the target page are fully loaded. You can adjust the maximum wait time by using the pageTimeout parameter. The overall execution duration is significantly affected by the resource loading status of the target site
description_zh:
通过浏览器沙箱环境读取 HTML 并解析网页内容。
接口将在目标页面资源完全加载后开始解析（可通过 pageTimeout 参数调整最大等待时长），接口整体耗时将显著受目标站点资源加载情况的影响
name: ReadPageScrape

parameters.help_en:
The formats of the parsed result. Valid values:
rawHtml: The HTML of the target site.
html: The page content processed based on the readabilityMode.
markdown: The Markdown content converted from the HTML.
text: The text content in the HTML.
screenshot: The screenshot of the target site
parameters.help_zh:
解析结果格式

rawHtml：目标站点的 html
html: 根据 readabilityMode 处理后的页面内容
markdown：根据 html 转换成的 markdown 内容
text：html 中的文本内容
screenshot: 目标站点截图
parameters.name: formats

parameters.help_en:
The maximum cache duration, in seconds.
If the cache duration is less than the maxAge value, the cached content is returned.
If the maxAge value is set to 0, the cache is not used.

Default value: 1296000
parameters.help_zh:
最大缓存时间，单位（秒），默认值：1296000。
若缓存时间小于 maxAge，则返回缓存内容；
若 maxAge 等于 0，则不使用缓存
parameters.name: max_age

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for waiting for the resources of the target site to fully load. The pageTimeout value must be less than the timeout value.

Default value: 15000
parameters.help_zh:
等待目标站点资源完全加载的超时时间，pageTimeout 应小于 timeout 时长

默认值：15000
parameters.name: page_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all images.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否剔除所有图片

默认值：false
fields.name: exclude_all_images

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all links.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否剔除所有链接

默认值：false
fields.name: exclude_all_links

fields.help_en:
The readability mode. Valid values:
none: Does not remove any information. This is the default value.
normal: Removes irrelevant information from the target page, such as headers, footers, and navigation elements, based on a proprietary algorithm.
article: Extracts the main body content of the site based on a proprietary algorithm. This mode is suitable for blogs and news sites, but not for directory or navigation pages
fields.help_zh:
none：不删除信息，默认为 none

normal: 基于自研算法，剔除目标页面无关信息（页头/页脚，导航等）

article: 基于自研算法，获取站点主要正文内容(适用于博客、新闻站点，不适用于目录页、导航页)
fields.name: readability_mode

parameters.help_en: The readability configuration of the parsed result
parameters.name: readability

parameters.help_en:
The end-to-end processing timeout period, in milliseconds.

Valid values: 0 to 180000.

Default value: 60000
parameters.help_zh:
全链路处理超时时间，单位：ms

可选值：[0, 180000]

默认值：60000
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The target URL to parse. It must start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 解析的目标地址，必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
parameters.name: url

data.description_zh: 目标 url 解析结果
